items.headline: RBI under pressure to hike repo rate amid rising inflation and strong growth
items.summary: A Reuters poll indicates over 60% of economists expect a 25 basis point hike to 5.50% at the upcoming October 5-7 policy meeting, driven by August inflation at 4.82% and robust economic growth. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra confirmed MPC will reassess dynamics.

items.headline: Indian Rupee weakens against US dollar due to crude oil price pressures
items.summary: The Indian rupee traded around 96.132 against the US dollar, reflecting increased import costs as crude oil prices rose. Principal Secretary Shaktikanta Das highlighted India's resilience but stressed reducing oil/gas import reliance.

items.headline: Elevated US Treasury yields fuel sustained FII outflows from India
items.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields surpassing 5% continued to attract foreign capital back to US debt markets. FIIs extended their selling streak for the fourth session, offloading nearly Rs 10,000 crore, contributing to $19.6 billion year-to-date outflows from Indian equities and bonds.

items.headline: Brent crude oil prices remain elevated amid Middle East tensions
items.summary: Brent crude oil traded near $97-$108 per barrel due to ongoing Middle East tensions and the US-Iran situation, posing a headwind for India's import bill and inflation outlook.

items.headline: Ceigall India reports 17% revenue growth, profit after tax up for FY26
items.summary: Ceigall India Limited's consolidated revenue from operations increased 17% year-on-year to ₹4,022 crore for FY26, with profit after tax reaching ₹309 crore. An analyst meeting was scheduled for Sept 30, 2026.

items.headline: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions to announce Q2 results
items.summary: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Ltd is scheduled to announce its quarterly results on October 1, 2026.

items.headline: IT sector leads market recovery, surges over 5%
items.summary: The Information Technology (IT) sector was the top performer, surging 5.45% and leading a broad-based market recovery. The Nifty MidSmall IT & Telecom index also saw significant gains.

items.headline: Nifty Pharma sector lags, healthcare and pharma indices decline
items.summary: The Nifty Pharma sector was the top laggard, declining 0.67%, with healthcare and pharmaceutical indices generally lower.

items.headline: Metal stocks experience selling pressure
items.summary: Metal stocks also experienced selling pressure, contributing to overall market dynamics.

items.headline: Oil & Gas and PSU Bank sectors see buying interest
items.summary: The oil & gas sector and PSU Bank sector witnessed buying interest from investors.

items.headline: KSB secures $12.40 million export order for boiler feed pump packages
items.summary: KSB received a $12.40 million export order from Dangote Projects Free Zone Enterprise for boiler feed pump packages.

items.headline: Prime Cable Industries receives ₹16.49 crore cable order
items.summary: Prime Cable Industries secured a ₹16.49 crore order for cables.

items.headline: Transport Corporation of India announces first-ever ₹150 crore buyback
items.summary: Transport Corporation of India (TCI) announced its first-ever buyback program worth ₹150 crore.

items.headline: Ramco Cements undertaking capacity expansion
items.summary: Ramco Cements is currently engaged in a capacity expansion initiative.

items.headline: NLC India approves 50:50 JV with NALCO for 1,080 MW power plant
items.summary: NLC India approved a 50:50 joint venture with National Aluminium Company (NALCO) to develop a 1,080 MW thermal captive power plant.

items.headline: Four companies debut on stock market; Adroit Industries sees 86% listing gain
items.summary: Elevate Campuses, ArMee Infotech, Swastika Infra, and Adroit Industries made their stock market debuts. Adroit Industries saw an 86% listing gain, while Elevate Campuses listed at a 2% discount.

items.headline: SAIL and Saraswati Saree Depot trade ex-dividend
items.summary: Steel Authority of India (SAIL) and Saraswati Saree Depot traded ex-dividend today.

items.headline: Avalon Technologies promoters to sell up to 6% stake via block deals
items.summary: Promoter groups of Avalon Technologies are expected to sell up to a 6% equity stake through block deals.

items.headline: Power Mech Projects secures ₹549.37 crore order from Adani Group
items.summary: Power Mech Projects secured an order worth ₹549.37 crore for operation and maintenance services at an Adani Group power project.

items.headline: Notable block deals executed in multiple companies
items.summary: Block deals included sales in 360 ONE WAM, Capital Small Finance Bank, Kajaria Ceramics, Honasa Consumer, and Cube Highways Trust, with institutional investors acquiring stakes in some of these, including Centum Electronics.

items.headline: Juniper Green Energy commissions 100.64 MWh BESS capacity
items.summary: A subsidiary of Juniper Green Energy commissioned 100.64 MWh of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity.

items.headline: IHH Healthcare reiterates plan to increase stake in Fortis Healthcare to 51%
items.summary: Malaysian healthcare giant IHH Healthcare reiterated plans to increase its stake in Fortis Healthcare to 51% over the next three to five years.

items.headline: PayU launches Apple Pay across its merchant network in India
items.summary: PayU launched Apple Pay across its merchant network in India, expanding digital payment options.

items.headline: Various corporate actions scheduled including demerger and acquisitions
items.summary: Almondz Global Securities scheduled a demerger, Apollo Pipes and Bartronics India planned preferential issues. Anupam Rasayan India is set to acquire shares of Tanfac Industries.

items.headline: TCS, ICICI Bank, HCL Technologies among Nifty50 top gainers
items.summary: Among the Nifty50, TCS, ICICI Bank, and HCL Technologies were the top gainers, contributing to the market's recovery.

items.headline: Sun Pharmaceutical, HDFC Bank, Titan Company among Nifty50 top losers
items.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical, HDFC Bank, and Titan Company were among the top losers in the Nifty50 index.

items.headline: Coforge emerges as leading gainer in large and midcap stocks
items.summary: Coforge showed strong performance, emerging as a leading gainer among large and midcap stocks.

items.headline: BSE and Wipro in focus due to Nifty 50 reshuffle
items.summary: BSE and Wipro were in focus, potentially due to a Nifty 50 reshuffle, alongside other companies like KPI Green Energy and Newgen Software due to corporate developments.

items.headline: Adani Group shares see significant movement
items.summary: Adani Group shares, including Adani Enterprises (hitting upper circuit), Adani Wilmar, and Adani Ports, saw significant movement yesterday (September 29).
